subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Name the eight planets in our solar system.
Read a science text and find facts about the planets.
Explain why we can live on Earth.

tf.s: There are eight planets in our solar system.
Earth goes around the Sun every 365 days.
We can live on Earth because there is air and water.
tf.why: Air and water help us live.

tf.s: Mercury and Venus are the farthest planets from the Sun.
tf.why: Uranus and Neptune are the farthest from the Sun.

tf.s: Saturn has a big ring around it.
tf.why: Saturn's big ring makes it amazing.
Jupiter is bigger than Earth. It is the biggest planet.
The lesson says Saturn has 146 moons.

tf.s: Earth goes around the Sun every 30 days.
tf.why: Earth goes around the Sun every 365 days.

tf.s: Neptune is the closest planet to the Sun.
tf.why: Mercury is the closest. Neptune is one of the farthest.

boxes.q: Which planet is second from the Sun?
Which planet has a big ring and 146 moons?
How long does it take for Earth to go around the Sun?
Which planets are the farthest from the Sun?
boxes.why: Uranus and Neptune are the farthest.

boxes.q: Which planet comes first from the Sun?
boxes.why: Mercury is the closest to the Sun.

boxes.q: What do we need to breathe?
Which planet is between Venus and Mars?
Which word means "to move in a circle around something"?

hunt.q: Days for Earth to go round

mcq.q: Which list has the eight planets in order from the Sun?
o: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune
Earth, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Neptune, Uranus
Mars, Venus, Earth, Mercury, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune, Uranus
Mercury, Earth, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Uranus, Saturn, Neptune
mcq.why: This is the order from the Sun.

o: It has 146 moons and a big ring around it.
It is the closest to the Sun.
mcq.why: Saturn has many moons and a big ring.

mcq.q: Which two planets are the farthest from the Sun?
mcq.why: Uranus and Neptune are the farthest.

o: Jupiter is more big than Earth.

mcq.q: How many years is 730 days for Earth?
Your friend asks: Which planet do we live on? What is the right answer?
o: We live on Earth, the third planet from the Sun.
We live on Mars, the first planet.
We live on Jupiter, the biggest planet.
mcq.why: Earth is third: Mercury, Venus, Earth.

mcq.q: Why can we live on Earth?
o: Because there is air and water.
Because it is the biggest planet.
Because it has a big ring.
Because it is very far from the Sun.
mcq.why: Living things need air and water.

mcq.q: Jupiter is the biggest planet. What does this tell you?
o: Jupiter is bigger than all the other planets.
Jupiter is the closest to the Sun.
mcq.why: The biggest means bigger than all the others.
Jupiter, not Saturn, is the biggest planet.
